# Measure total workflow cost — applied workshop

You support an internal knowledge desk. Calculate net minutes saved at two thresholds and identify omitted costs.

## Concept setup · 10 minutes
Include review time, retries, maintenance and setup as well as generation. Estimate ranges. Time saved does not automatically equal cash saved.

## Implementation · 20 minutes
Compare 8 baseline minutes per record with 2 assisted minutes plus 7 review minutes for missing/low confidence, or 1 minute otherwise. Open the starter notebook or visual workflow simulator.

## Task · 20 minutes
Calculate net minutes saved at two thresholds and identify omitted costs. Record a normal, missing-input and human-review case.

## Research and discussion · 15 minutes
Compare with a peer, cite your reading and identify a failure condition.

## Wrap-up · 5 minutes
Explain why a simulation is not a production-ready system; name the accountable owner.

## Submission
Draft cohort policy: 2–3-page APA-style paper with relevant code, output screenshots and citations. Word/PDF upload and Sunday 11:59 PM deadline need a scheduled cohort; no live deadline is set.

## Integrity
AI coaching on concepts and ungraded practice is allowed with disclosure. Graded reasoning must be your own.
